purpose: The lab handbook: how the lab runs day to day.

entries.title: Office hours
entries.body: The lab is open 9 to 5 on weekdays. The PI holds office hours on Tuesday and Thursday from 2 to 4 pm in room 312. Book a slot in the shared calendar.

facts.text: PI office hours are Tuesday and Thursday 2 to 4 pm.

entries.title: Data classes
entries.body: D0 is public. D1 is internal. D2 is confidential. D3 is restricted and includes participant identifiers such as P-12345 codes and any health record. R is review-confidential and never leaves the lab. Restricted data never goes to a hosted model.

entries.title: Onboarding
entries.body: New members complete the CITI human subjects training in their first week, get a lab drive account, and read the data classes page before touching any dataset.

entries.title: Equipment
entries.body: The eye tracker lives in room 310 and is booked through the equipment calendar. Return cables to the labelled drawer. Report faults to the lab manager.
